trinova_validation_hypothesis: Evaluate bafetinib for differential cell-cycle response in BUB1B-perturbed versus control models.

trinova_validation_hypothesis: Evaluate 4-chlorophenylguanidine for differential cell-cycle response in BUB1B-perturbed versus control models.
